notes: SHIP v1.14.425 - COMMAND DECK LAYOUT REACHES THE PHONE (owner override). WHAT THIS IS. A layout port, not a redesign. The approved Command Deck already existed in full as #cmd-shell and had been gated @media (min-width:1024px) since v1.14.412, because no phone composition had been authored for it. The consequence was that a phone fell back to the older Command page while the approved layout sat inert in the same file. This ship opens that gate to every width and adds ONE @media (max-width:1023px) block that adapts only the parts a desktop composition cannot carry onto a phone: the fixed 246px rail, the two-column main/right grid, and the paired ops and tools grids. The cards, the hero, the KPI row, the intelligence panel, LOCAL SYSTEM STATE, build progress, field operations, field tools and shift readiness all keep the styling they already had - reusing them is the point of opening the gate rather than rebuilding them. TWO THINGS THE GATE-OPEN BROKE, BOTH CAUGHT BY MEASUREMENT AND BOTH FIXED. 1. CHROME. The desktop block hands navigation duty to #cs-side and #cs-top, which only exist at 1024 and above, and therefore stands the shared .app-header and #rd-botnav down. Carried to a phone that left NO navigation and NO version, service-worker or network pills - measured .app-header display none and #rd-botnav display none at 390. Those three rules are now sub-gated to @media (min-width:1024px) at their own source, so the chrome contract stays where the organs that honour it exist. Navigation architecture is unchanged and no metadata was removed. 2. CONTAINER PADDING. #cs-lower is a grid CONTAINER that wears .cs-dpanel only to inherit that class's display toggle, and inherited its 16px/17px CARD padding with it. Invisible in a wide three-up row; at 390 it inset the lower three cards to 328px against the 362px stack above them, a visible 17px step in a single column. Reset to zero in the phone block only. ALSO REQUIRED, AND WHY. Narrowing the grid template is not sufficient on its own: the right-column cards carry an explicit grid-column 2, and a child placed in column 2 of a one-column grid creates an IMPLICIT second column - measured, the template computed to 0px 347px and the hero was squeezed to 52px wide and 741px tall underneath the stack. The desktop also places the hero and the intelligence panel both in row 1; released from the column but not the row they stacked ON TOP of each other, measured at hero y0 h741 and intel y0 h225. Column and row are two separate placements and a single column has to release both. MEASURED AT 390x844 WEBKIT, PROFILE PLUS 24-RACK MASTER SEEDED: docW 390, no horizontal overflow, seven cards in one column at x14 w362 in mock order - hero, intelligence, local system state, build progress, field operations, field tools, shift readiness. .app-header h68 visible, #rd-botnav h111 visible. TIER OUTCOMES. Phone 390 and tablet 834 compose the deck single-column with the shared header and the bottom nav - single column at tablet is an owner ruling this ship. Laptop 1366 and desktop 1440 measured identical to v1.14.424: 274px rail gutter, hero 803x741, two-column main/right, bottom nav stood down. The ?cshell=0 rip cord still returns the old phone Command page. SCOPE. Every added rule is body.rd.cshell scoped, so ?legacy=1 is untouched by construction. No state logic, no gates, no data-honesty behaviour, no baked artwork, no navigation change, no metadata removal, no 44px target relaxed, no unrelated screen touched. TESTS. Two assertions in 06-composition.spec.js pinned #cmd-shell display none below 1024 - the exact contract the owner override changed. That clause was updated and nothing else: the chrome assertions those tests exist to protect (rail inert, top bar inert, bottom nav still routing below 1024, both standing down at 1024) are unchanged and still green. The viewport-follows-resize probe moved from #cmd-shell to #cs-side, because the rail is now the organ that must appear and disappear on resize. No allow-list widened. GATES: inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, braces balanced, CRLF intact, three-stamp lockstep. DEVICE-VERIFY: open Command on the iPhone. Expect the hero card with rack art, the RACKS/BLOCKERS/COMPLETE KPI row, START A DEPLOYMENT, PHANTOM INTELLIGENCE, LOCAL SYSTEM STATE, BUILD PROGRESS, FIELD OPERATIONS, FIELD TOOLS and SHIFT READINESS stacked in one column - with the PHANTOM header and its version badge at the top and the bottom nav still on screen and still routing. Confirm no sideways scroll at any point in that stack.
